# Logo sources

Logos are kept in the repo so Flock never hotlinks an image. Each one was
checked for scripts and event handlers before it was committed.

| Files | Source |
|---|---|
| `postgresql.svg`, `metabase.svg`, `n8n.svg`, `github.svg`, `docker.svg`, `1password.svg`, `cloudflare.svg`, `google-drive.svg`, `google-sheets.svg`, `google-forms.svg`, `slack.svg`, `shopify.svg`, `ups.svg` | [homarr-labs/dashboard-icons](https://github.com/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons) |
| `gmail.svg`, `notion.svg`, `openai.svg`, `google-gemini.svg`, `webhook.svg`, `anthropic.svg` (`claude-ai.svg`), `google-cloud.svg` (`google-cloud-platform.svg`) | [homarr-labs/dashboard-icons](https://github.com/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons) at commit `59f1e9a4108f4f510f41e9588f078631de1e1405` |
| `fedex.svg`, `google-apps-script.svg`, `openrouter.svg` | [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org) (CC0), with a fill colour added |
| `cin7.svg`, `cin7.png` | Cin7's own product icon and favicon |
| `shipstation.png`, `freightos.png`, `unishippers.png`, `freightdesk.png` | Each company's own favicon |

All product names, logos and trademarks belong to their owners. Flock uses them
only to show which system a workflow step talks to. Flock is not affiliated with
or endorsed by any of them, including n8n GmbH.
